svg.title: The Dapr building block APIs
svg.desc: Fifteen cards, five across and three down, one for each Dapr building block API. Workflows automate and orchestrate tasks within your application. Publish and subscribe provides secure, scalable messaging between services. Service invocation performs direct, secure, service to service method calls. State management creates long running, stateless and stateful services. Actors encapsulate code and data in reusable actor objects. Jobs schedules tasks to run at specified intervals or times. Configuration accesses application configuration and is notified of updates. Secrets securely accesses secrets from your application. Bindings provides input and output bindings to external resources, including databases and queues. Six more are in alpha: cryptography performs operations for encrypting and decrypting data, distributed lock gives mutually exclusive access to shared resources, conversation converses between different large language models, binary store stores, retrieves and deletes binary files, search indexes and queries JSON documents, and vector stores vectors and runs similarity queries.
